description: Write a pandas ETL script for health_portal that enriches encounter records with a diagnosis category from an effective-dated reference table. The script should: (1) normalize dx_code on both sides (trim, upper case), (2) join each encounter to the mapping version in effect on the encounter_date (effective_from <= encounter_date, choosing the latest such version), (3) set dx_category to 'UNMAPPED' when no mapping exists, (4) guarantee that the output has exactly one row per encounter. In the sample, rows are tagged with _dataset = encounters or icd_map.
edge_cases: A plain merge on dx_code returns two rows for every E11.9 encounter because the map has two versions
e2 needs trimming and upper-casing before it matches
e3 has no mapping and must be kept (left join) with 'UNMAPPED'
An encounter dated before the earliest effective_from of its code is UNMAPPED, not matched to a later version
Output row count must equal the encounter count; assert it
common_failure_modes: FM1: Join on code alone fans out encounters across mapping versions
FM1: Inner join drops unmapped encounters
FM2: Picking the latest mapping version regardless of encounter_date rewrites historical categories
